title: CustomerOverride
description: Customer-side override layer per ARCHITECT-REPLY-51 D8. Composition: effective_config = deepMerge(base_profile, override). Overrides must not introduce fields absent from the base profile schema; the loader enforces this (schema-enforced structural constraint).

customer_id.description: Stable customer identifier; threaded through audit for attribution.

overrides.description: Partial profile shape. Loader enforces that every leaf key must be a valid path in the base profile schema (no new fields; schema-enforced per D8). Array fields replace parent arrays entirely (D4 semantics propagate to override layer). `null` values disable a base-profile field.
